chapter.verse: Tua bang ahih leh, Pasian in ama mipawlte a paaikhia hiam? A paaikhia kei hi, ka ci hi. Keimah in zong Abraham’ suan, Benjamin’ mipawl Israel mi ka hi hi.
Pasian in a theih kholh ama mite a paaikhia kei hi.

Kamsangpa Elijah in, “Topa aw, amaute in nangma kamsangte a that zo uh hi; nangma biakna taute a sugawp zo uh hi. Kei guak ka om lai hangin keima nuntakna hong zong uh hi,” ci-in Pasian mai-ah Israel mite lang khatah thu a ngen hi cihna Lai Siangtho thu thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian in zong ama kiangah bang ci gen ahi hiam? “Baal mai-ah a khukdin’ lo mi tul sagih keimah ading ka om sak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin tu lai takin hehpihna hangah a kiteelsa kimkhat a om lai uh hi.
Hehpihna hangah ahih leh, gamtatna hang ahi kei hi. Tua bang ahih kei leh, hehpihna in hehpihna ahi kei hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang ci ahi hiam? Israel mite in a zon’ uh hangin a mu kei uh hi. A teelsate bek in a ngah uh hi. A om lai mite in a lung a khauhsak uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Lai Siangtho sungah, “Pasian a mu thei lo mittang ahi zongin, khua a za thei lo bil ahi zongin, a ihmu nuam lungsim tua mite tungah tuni dongin a pia hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
David in: “Amau’ ankuang un amau tungah tehlop ahi zongin, thangzak ahi zongin, kisuih khak a, kipukna ahi zongin, daantatna ahi zongin hi ta hen.
Amaute in a muh zawh loh nadingun amau mittang uh mial ta hen. Amau nung uh a tawntungin na kulsak in,” ci-in a gelh hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, amaute a puk dongun a sui kha uh hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo hi. Amau sungah een’na om nadingin, amaute a pukna hangin Gentailte in gupna a ngah uh hi.
Amau pukna un leitungmite hauhna hi a, amau tan’na un Gentailte hauhna ahih leh, amaute kicin’na un hauhna tamzaw piang sak ding hilo ahi hiam?
Gentailte ahi note kiangah kong gen hi. Gentailte’ sawltak ka hi ahih ciangin,
ka ci ka sa pawlte lung sungah een’na piang sakin lam khatpeuh mah tawh, kimkhat ka gup zawh khak nadingin, ka za ka phat hi.
Tua mite kipaih khiatna un leitung mite’ kilem kikna a pian’sak leh, amau kikoihcin’na un sihna pan thawhkikna hilo ahi hiam?
A kipia masa buhneel a sian’tho leh, a lompi in a siangtho ding hi. A zung a sian’tho leh, a hiangte zong a siangtho ding uh hi.
A hiang kimkhat in a kitan khit ciangin gamlak oliv hiang ahi nangmah in, amau pum tungah pehin kibulh a, hiangte tawh kibangin oliv sing thazung tui zomin na neek leh,
a kitankhia hiangte kosia-in na kisathei kei in. Na kisaktheih leh, nangmah in a zung na pua kei hi, zung in nang hong pua zaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nang in, “Kei hong peh nadingin hiangte a kitan hi,” ci-in nong ci ding hi.
Hi ta hen. Upna lungsim nei lo ahih ciangun amaute a kitan uh a, nangmah in na upna hang bekin na kip hi. Na kisathei kei in, na kihta in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Pasian in a hiang taktakte pammaih a sak kei leh, nangmah zong pammaih hong sa ding ahi kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a puk mite tungah a thukhenna ahi zongin, ama hehpihna sungah na kip leh, nangmah tungah Pasian’ hehpihna ahi zongin, hih thu nih na ngaihsun in. Ama hehpihna sungah na kip kei leh, phuk tanna na thuak ding hi.
Amaute in zong amau up lohna sungah a om kei uh leh, a kung tungah zom kikin peh kik nading thu a ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in amaute khatvei a peh kik thei hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gamlak oliv kung taktak panin hong sat tanin, oliv kung hoih tungah ngeina zui loin nang hong kipeh leh, hiang taktakte ahi uh tua mite in amau oliv kungah zomin peh kik nading a ngah zaw ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Ute naute aw, na kisaktheih loh nadingun Gentailte khempeuh hong lut khit matengin, Israel mite tungah khuamialna tawm a tung hi ci-in hih thuthuk thei loin na om ding uh ka ut kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in gupna a ngah ding uh hi. Tua a kigelhna in: “Zion Mual tungah Gumpa hong pai ding a, Pasian zahtak lohna Jakob’ suante lak pan a lakhia ding hi.
Amaute mawhna ke’n ka lakkhiat khit ciangin, Amau tungah ka piak thuciamna in, tua thu ahi ding hi” a ci hi.
Amaute in Lungdamna Thu pan note hangin galte ahi uh hi. Teelkhiatna thu panin pute pate hangin a ki-it mi ahi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ hehpihna thupha leh hong sapna in a thu a kidok kik ngei kei hi.
Note in nidang lai-inah Pasian’ thu na man’loh uh hangin, tu-in amau thuman’lohna hangin hehpihna na ngah uh mah bangin,
note ngahsa hangah amaute in zong hehpihna a ngah nadingun, tu-in thungai loin a om uh hi.
Pasian in mi khempeuh hong hehpih theih nadingin mi khempeuh thungaih lohna sungah a khumcip hi.
Pasian’ hauhna leh pilna leh siamna in bang zahin thuk hiam! A thukhennate kuamah in thei zo lo hi! A paina lampi zui-in i zon’ hangin i mu zo kei hi!
Topa’ lungsim kua in a thei ngei hiam? Amah tawh a vaihawm kua ahi ngei hiam?
A thukkik dingin na khat peuhpeuh kua in Pasian tungah pia ngei hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na khempeuh in amah panin ahi zongin, amah hangin ahi zongin, amah adingin ahi zongin a piang uh hi. A tawntungin amah in minthan’na ngah ta hen. Amen.
